data.headline: Hacker house in the Mission, network in SoMa

picks.name: Hacker house (Mission or SoMa)
picks.one_liner: Tight budget, short sprint: roommates become cofounder leads and angel intros.
picks.insider: Find openings via Luma/X posts and founder group chats, not listing sites.

picks.name: Mission / Valencia
picks.one_liner: Latino community, great cafés, hacker houses, quick ride to SoMa events.
picks.insider: Stay near the Valencia corridor; 16th & Mission BART area is rough at night.

picks.name: Furnished sublet in Hayes Valley / Lower Haight
picks.one_liner: Quiet, central, livable backup if no hacker house opens up.
picks.insider: Use Facebook groups, Craigslist, Furnished Finder; video-call inside before paying anything.

data.watch_out: Cheap 'near Union Square' listings are often Tenderloin. Check the map; skip Richmond/Sunset for a sprint.

data.headline: Free hidden spots, cheap day passes

picks.name: Capital One Café
picks.one_liner: Free seat, solid Wi‑Fi, quiet: ideal for tight budget and investor emails.
picks.insider: Not just for customers. Open seating plus discounted coffee; out-of-towners rarely know.

picks.name: Day-pass coworkings
picks.one_liner: For 2–4 weeks, day passes beat a monthly desk; meet fintech founders.
picks.insider: Buy passes only on meeting-heavy days; use free spots otherwise.

picks.name: Salesforce Park
picks.one_liner: Free rooftop base in SoMa between angel and cofounder meetings.
picks.insider: Laptop-friendly benches; great for taking calls between nearby SoMa meetings.

data.watch_out: Core Café is the obvious pick and gets packed. Go early or keep a backup.

data.headline: Hack at EF, party at El Gato Volador

picks.name: Entrepreneurs First (EF)
picks.one_liner: Free hackathons to meet technical cofounders fast on a tight budget.
picks.insider: Go even without winning plans; bring your invoicing demo on your phone, not a deck.

picks.name: El Gato Volador
picks.one_liner: Latino tech crowd who get LatAm SMB pain and can intro angels.
picks.insider: Posted on Luma; follow the calendar so you catch dates during your November window.

picks.name: Luma + X outreach
picks.one_liner: Find fintech founders and pre-seed angels; book quiet café coffee chats.
picks.insider: Post 'landing Nov 9, building AI invoicing for LatAm, coffee's on me' on X.

data.watch_out: Good Luma events fill fast—apply early, ideally before you land, given only 2–4 weeks.

data.headline: Lime pass by day, Muni backup, Waymo late

picks.name: Lime (monthly pass)
picks.one_liner: Cheapest fast way to hop between founder events and cafés on tight budget.
picks.insider: Buy the monthly pass day one; covers a 2–4 week stay nicely.

picks.name: Muni bus / metro
picks.one_liner: Rainy November days or longer trips like the Mission's Latino corridor.
picks.insider: Add Clipper to Apple/Google Wallet; skip buying physical cards.

picks.name: Waymo (or Lyft/Uber)
picks.one_liner: Safe ride home after late hackathons and investor dinners.
picks.insider: Try Waymo once; feels safer solo at night than rideshare.

data.watch_out: Use BART only for SFO/East Bay; it's not useful for getting around inside SF.

data.headline: Sofía: meet LatAm fintech builders, a technical cofounder, and pre-seed angels — demo on phone, coffee's on you.

targets.who: Seed-stage fintech founder selling into Latin America
targets.why: Knows LatAm payments, compliance, investors; can intro angels and engineers.
targets.linkedin_search: founder fintech Latin America San Francisco seed
targets.dm: Hi! I'm Sofía, building AI invoicing for LatAm SMBs. In SF Nov 9 for a few weeks. Loved how you've tackled LatAm payments. Could I buy you a coffee for 30 min? I'll show a quick demo on my phone.

targets.who: Technical AI engineer, ex-fintech, exploring next startup
targets.why: Potential cofounder who can own the AI and payments stack.
targets.linkedin_search: machine learning engineer fintech San Francisco Spanish
targets.dm: Hi! I'm Sofía, building AI invoicing for LatAm SMBs and looking for a technical cofounder. In SF from Nov 9. Your fintech + ML background stood out. Coffee's on me, 30 min? Happy to demo what I've built.

targets.who: Pre-seed angel investing in LatAm or SMB fintech
targets.why: Writes first checks; understands SMB fintech and LatAm markets.
targets.linkedin_search: angel investor pre-seed fintech LatAm San Francisco
targets.dm: Hi! I'm Sofía, founder of an AI invoicing tool for LatAm SMBs. In SF Nov 9 for 2–4 weeks. Saw your LatAm fintech angel bets. Could I buy you coffee? No deck, just a 5-min phone demo and your honest feedback.

data.x_post: Landing in SF Nov 9 for 2–4 weeks 🇺🇸 Building AI invoicing for Latin American SMBs. Looking for a technical cofounder and to meet fintech founders and pre-seed angels. Coffee's on me ☕ DMs open!
